verdict.label: not_supported_today
rationale: Core check E1 is contrary: the claim needs net income to grow 55.19% per year from 40.00M (FY ending 2025-12-31) to 500.00M by about 2031-09-30 (5.75 years); reported growth was 12.62% per year (2022–2025).
E2 is supporting: the claim assumes P/E 20 at the target date; today's P/E is 118.75 (market value 4.75B / net income 40.00M), so the assumption is at or below today's level.
E3 is supporting: going from 95.00M reported shares to the assumed 100.00M means 0.99% per year; the reported count changed 1.04% per year (2023-07-28 to 2026-07-24).
The growth gap of 42.56 pp per year exceeds the 15.00 pp limit of rules-v1.
limitations: Synthetic example data was used. This verdict demonstrates the rules and says nothing about a real company.

Evidence as of 2026-10-01. 'Not Supported Today' describes the state of the evidence on that date. Not Supported Today does not mean the target price is impossible; Supported Today is not a guarantee.
Rules and thresholds are provisional (rules-v1); team validation of verdict thresholds is still open.
Checks use reported financial history and market prices only. Filing text, guidance and news are not read; AI-assisted analysis (OA.10–OA.12) is not implemented.
rationale_zh: 核心检查 E1 为反对：观点要求净利润从 4,000 万（截至 2025-12-31 的财年）在约 5.75 年内（到 2031-09-30 前后）增长到 5.00 亿，即每年 55.19%；已披露增速为每年 12.62%（2022–2025）。
E2 为支持：观点假设目标日 P/E 为 20；当前 P/E 为 118.75（市值 47.50 亿 / 净利润 4,000 万），假设不高于当前水平。
E3 为支持：从已披露的 9,500 万 股到假设的 1.00 亿 股，即每年 0.99%；已披露股份数每年变化 1.04%（2023-07-28 至 2026-07-24）。
增速差距每年 42.56 pp，超过 rules-v1 的 15.00 pp 上限。
limitations_zh: 本次使用合成示例数据。这个结论只用来演示规则，与任何真实公司无关。
证据截至 2026-10-01。「目前证据不支持」描述的是当日的证据状态。「目前证据不支持」不表示目标价不可能达到，「目前证据支持」也不是保证。
规则和阈值是临时的（rules-v1），判断阈值尚待团队验证。
检查只使用已披露的财务历史和市场价格，不读取申报正文、管理层指引和新闻；AI 辅助分析（OA.10–OA.12）尚未实现。

headline.en: Probability that Synthetic Example Corp (fictional) is at or above 100 by about Sep 2031: about <0.1%–15.9%, unlikely. The business would need net income growth of 55.2% a year; it has managed +12.6%. The methods disagree: Option market (implied) gives 15.9%, Base rate (similar companies) gives <0.1%. They measure different things: what traders with money at stake price in, via implied volatility; versus how many US companies of similar size grew net income as fast as the claim needs.
headline.zh: Synthetic Example Corp (fictional) 到 2031 年 9 月前后达到 100 的概率约 <0.1%–15.9%，属于「不太可能」。业绩上，净利润需要每年增长 55.2%，过去是每年 +12.6%。各方法差别较大：期权市场（隐含）给出 15.9%，历史基准率（同规模公司）给出 <0.1%。它们衡量的东西不同：前者是真金白银交易的期权，通过隐含波动率反映的定价；后者是规模相近的美国上市公司里，净利润增速达到观点要求的比例。

verdict_meaning.zh: 按今天的公开数据，观点需要的远超公司过去的表现。这不代表不可能，但需要发生很大的变化。

limitations.en: Probability of the business condition, not of the price; the valuation assumption still has to hold.
limitations.zh: 这是业绩条件的概率，不是股价的概率；估值假设仍需成立。

limitations.en: Survivors only: companies that reported in both years. Acquired or delisted companies are missing, which makes the rate optimistic.
limitations.zh: 只统计两年都还在申报的公司，被收购或退市的公司不在其中，所以比例偏乐观。

measures.en: share of past windows of the same length in which this stock rose at least as much
measures.zh: 过去相同长度的时间段里，这只股票涨幅达到要求的比例

detail.en: not enough price history for a window this long

agreement.en: The methods disagree: Option market (implied) gives 15.9%, Base rate (similar companies) gives <0.1%. They measure different things: what traders with money at stake price in, via implied volatility; versus how many US companies of similar size grew net income as fast as the claim needs.
agreement.zh: 各方法差别较大：期权市场（隐含）给出 15.9%，历史基准率（同规模公司）给出 <0.1%。它们衡量的东西不同：前者是真金白银交易的期权，通过隐含波动率反映的定价；后者是规模相近的美国上市公司里，净利润增速达到观点要求的比例。

warnings: synthetic example data is used for public sources in this run, not real SEC or market data
warnings_zh: 本次公开数据使用合成示例数据，不是真实的 SEC 或市场数据
disclaimer: TickerCase checks what a claim requires under the user's assumptions against dated public data. The verdict describes the evidence as of a date; it is not a price prediction, a guarantee or investment advice. The optional probability section is a model output under stated assumptions and is not part of the verdict.
